id.instruksi: Dengarkan tebakan dan hasilnya. Mendukung atau tidak?
id.t-es: Tebakan: es di bawah Matahari mencair lebih dulu. Hasil: es di bawah Matahari habis lebih dulu.
id.t-tanaman: Tebakan: tanaman di jendela tumbuh paling tinggi. Hasil: tanaman di lemari tumbuh paling tinggi.
id.t-mobil: Tebakan: mobil meluncur paling jauh di lantai licin. Hasil: mobil meluncur paling jauh di lantai keramik.
id.t-gula: Tebakan: gula larut dalam air. Hasil: gula tetap terlihat di dasar gelas setelah diaduk lama.
id.t-bayangan: Tebakan: bayangan membesar saat boneka didekatkan ke senter. Hasil: bayangan jadi besar.
id.t-magnet: Tebakan: magnet menarik kaleng minuman. Hasil: kaleng minuman tidak bergerak.
id.t-jemuran: Tebakan: baju di bawah Matahari kering lebih dulu. Hasil: baju di dalam rumah kering lebih dulu.
id.t-bola: Tebakan: bola karet memantul lebih tinggi dari bola kain. Hasil: bola karet memantul lebih tinggi.
id.t-serap: Tebakan: spons menyerap air paling banyak. Hasil: kain menyerap paling banyak, spons kedua.
id.t-kecambah: Tebakan: biji yang disiram tumbuh lebih cepat. Hasil: biji yang disiram tumbuh duluan.

en.judul: Do the Results Support the Prediction?
en.instruksi: Listen to the prediction and the result. Do they match or not?
en.t-es: Prediction: the ice in the sun melts first. Result: the ice in the sun was gone first.
en.t-tanaman: Prediction: the plant by the window grows tallest. Result: the plant in the cupboard grew tallest.
en.t-mobil: Prediction: the car slides farthest on the smooth floor. Result: the car slid farthest on the tiled floor.
en.t-gula: Prediction: sugar dissolves in water. Result: the sugar stayed at the bottom after lots of stirring.
en.t-bayangan: Prediction: the shadow grows when the teddy moves closer to the torch. Result: the shadow got bigger.
en.t-magnet: Prediction: the magnet pulls the drink can. Result: the can didn't move.
en.t-jemuran: Prediction: the shirt in the sun dries first. Result: the shirt indoors dried first.
en.t-bola: Prediction: the rubber ball bounces higher than the cloth ball. Result: the rubber ball bounced higher.
en.t-serap: Prediction: the sponge soaks up the most water. Result: the cloth soaked up the most, the sponge came second.
en.t-kecambah: Prediction: watered seeds sprout faster. Result: the watered seeds sprouted first.
